profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Highly motivated and enthusiastic software engineer, passionate about technology, with proven experience (10+ years) in designing as well as developing highly scalable and fault tolerant back end applications written in java and more recently in erlang-OTP  as well. Reliable and hard working team player who always seeks for the best solution in a methodical and open minded way, giving much importance to detail and analysis, as well as creativity, with a need to understand technologies as opposed to just using them. As a special ability, it could be highlighted an ease in learning and assimilating new technologies, and as special interests, different concurrency models,  Functional programming , Object Oriented Analysis and Design, Scala and  all aspects of distributed systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: As a member of the Core team of Altruist, the Accounts team, led the Beneficiary improvements initiative, by coordinating different lines of work for ultimately reconciling data in our clearing platform and our accounts platform and also developed a daily job using Temporal and Snowflake for detecting, identifying and displaying all the different types of data points divergences between the 2 platforms and automatic code generation to fix them.
positions.insights: Skills: Temporal · Snowflake · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- As Principal Software Engineer for the NoteIt App, most notably re architected and implemented the whole push notifications pipeline improving accuracy in the intended delivery time as well as improving scalability and fault tolerance under Google Cloud using a mix of G-pub/sub, G-Cloud Tasks, G-Dataflow streaming jobs with change streams, G-functions, G-functions gen2, Java, Typescript and OneSignal client.

- I also migrated key data from Postgres to Spanner using Google Dataflow and migrated several services written in typescript to make use of Spanner instead of Postgres
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Google Cloud Dataflow

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Successfully led the company’s top project, the multi tier org. Was responsible for the  architecture design, general tech direction and most of the implementation of the backend and worked extremely close with product, the frontend team, the backend team and DevOps.The project was based on Spring Boot and Spring WebFlux, API driven using SwaggerHub as a means of contract between frontend and backend, developed under AWS and integrated with Aurora DB.

- Also led the roles shift system re architecture project which relied on a heavily decentralized architecture with profuse use of AWS Lambdas and queuing technologies to form a highly cohesive loosely coupled system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Completed new search service based on Spring Boot and Spring WebFlux which used the latest version of Elasticsearch to perform indexing and searches. Added new features to our own erlang client for pulsar and made use of it through different parts of the system to improve scalability and fault tolerance like for example making indexing requests go through pulsar leveraging the retry mechanism and adding back pressure through pulsar throttling feature

positions.title: Platform Engineer
positions.description:
Most notably, architected and implemented a pulsar binary protocol (protocol buffers) client in erlang supporting ssl, configurable exponential backoff retry mechanism, dead letter queue policies, pooling, proxy based connections and broker based.... 
Also used the client to migrate a legacy queue system to pulsar improving scalability, maintainability and fault tolerance, the client has been also successfully used for some new projects with the same results.

Also, specially at the begining, worked on a variety of features and fixes for our main projects and made relevant contributions in the conversation store project which aimed at reducing the latency of loading messages in the app and relied heavily on redis and cassandra.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
On one of the most complex projects where a daily feed had to be provided to Yelp,i led the part where the interaction with the Yelp Rest API takes place, making the feed calls and keeping track of the status of the individual items of the feed at different stages.
I also implemented a Facebook POC, including the front end and integrated with the Graph API and Marketing API. Currently working on the migration of a legacy project written in Scala

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of the Ad Delivery group, during the development of an AdWords like API based also on SOAP, i leaded the OAuth2 effort, implementing an OAuth2 server prototype, all the client code and clarifying and helping engineers and product owners alike understand OAuth2, i also led designing and developing the reporting part of the API, an asynchronous one based on ActiveMQ on a multi colo, multi node fail over setup

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of the Content team reimplemented the content details service using MongoDB, Spring Data, and EhCache. This cache solution allowed changes in the published content go live from 1 day in the previous solution to 60 seconds top. Also did extensive contributions to the development of the Publisher service, a REST API integrated with MongoDB used by the different content tools to publish content. 

Wrote a prototype to deal with large size XML files based on the high performance VTD-XML parser, performed multiple improvements to different jobs based on Spring Integration and promoted the use of different Java libraries to improve code quality. Implemented third party TV content matching with SOLR

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As part of the AdEngine team, made improvements to the core jobs for the business like the parallelization of the ads index (Lucene) creation. Also contributed on the core APIs of the business developing with other engineers the Budget API.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a member of the Bizrate Product Development team, participated in the design and implementation of the Ad Retargeting platform which developed in a short period of time and with excellent performance received quick partnership approval by Google and Yahoo. I designed and developed the mobile device detection component of the bizrate website and also participated in the Email Retargeting project, more specifically on the account management having to deal with the accounts system which sits on top of Oracle Coherence and with StrongMail through its REST client. Also developed numerous smaller projects on the Bizrate and Shopzilla Webapp which is a heavily decentralized REST arquitecture with special emphasis on performance.
